examples.arabic: هي كانت معاها خمسين جنيه بس، يعني مش كفاية لكل القماش ده.
examples.english: She only had fifty pounds with her, meaning it wasn't enough for all this fabric.
examples.transliteration: Heyya kanet ma3aha khamsin gineih bas, ya3ny mish kefaya le koll el-oumash dah.

examples.arabic: فجأة لقيت مفيش ملح كفاية بس انا كملت الطبخ
examples.english: Suddenly, I found there wasn't enough salt, but I continued cooking.
examples.transliteration: Fag'a la'eet mafish malh kefaya bas ana kammelt el tabkh.

examples.arabic: معايا خمسمية جنيه بس، وده مش كفاية أبداً.
examples.english: I only have five hundred pounds, and this is never enough.
examples.transliteration: Ma'aya khomsumiyah geneh bas, we da mesh kefayah abadan.

examples.arabic: امي قالت مفيش فاكهة ولا خضار كفاية
examples.english: My mother said there's not enough fruit or vegetables.
examples.transliteration: Ommy alet mafish fakha wala khodaar kefaya
